Name: Remind To Exit
Author: pepoluan
Description:
[i][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ffff00][b]Donation Points (DP) goes 100% to "Doctors without Borders" [/b][/color][/font][/i][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ffff00][b](Médecins sans Frontières)[/b][/color][/font][i]
[/i]
Have you ever experienced this:
[list]
[*]You're halfway into a day
[*]You encountered something that made you think, "If only there's a mod that can help me with this..."
[*]You paused the game, go to NexusMods, search a bit ... and found a mod that [i]exactly[/i] solves your issue!
[*]You downloaded the mod, and promised yourself, "I'm gonna exit the game next start of day and install this mod!"
[*]You continue playing go to sleep, wake up, do all morning stuff like watering your plants, rush to the house of your loved one because it's their birthday, grab a quest, go to the mines to solve the quest ...
[*]... you realize that you should've exited the game and installed [i]that mod[/i], but because you're better than halfway through the game, you keep continuing and promising yourself, "I'm gonna exit the game next start of day and install that mod!"
[*]Repeat the above 2 steps indefinitely.
[/list]
I have.

That's why I make this mod.

Whenever I reached point #4 above, I press F7 (customizable; see below), and next start of day, I'll be reminded to exit the game. If I change my mind, I'll just press F7 again and the reminder is deactivated.

[b]tl;dr:[/b] This mod does one thing and one thing only: Reminds you to EXIT THE GAME on next DayStart. Activate reminder by F7. Deactivate by F7 again.


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Installation[/size][/font][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Extract this mod to the Mods folder
[*]...
[*]Profit!
[/list]


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][font=Courier New]config.json[/font] knobs[/size][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]Enabled [/font]-- if [i]false[/i], then this mod will not do anything
[*][font=Courier New]HotKeyActivate [/font]-- defaults to "F7"
[*][font=Courier New]HotKeyCustomMessage [/font]-- defaults to "RightShift+F7". Activate, but with a Custom Message (for further reminding you what to do)
[/list]

[b]Yes, this mod supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]"Generic Mod Config Menu"[/url]﻿[/b].


[b][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5]Internationalization / Translation[/size][/font][/b]
I used [url=https://www.deepl.com/translator][b]DeepL Translate[/b][/url] to provide translation for German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, and Chinese (Simplified). I cannot vouch for the accuracy of the translation; blame DeepL if they're wrong.
